_doc: The one-click GRPO recipe of `rl train` (OE-T1 v0.3: the agent trains; the verifier only evaluates the shipped checkpoint). Defaults 50 steps x 8 tasks x n=8, lr 1e-6, checkpoints every 5 steps; `rl train --config FILE` changes the settable keys within the ranges in service.json train_config.
algorithm: GRPO, Miles 3ad61b8, synchronous colocated on 4 GPUs (Megatron TP2 x DP2, CPU Adam; 4 SGLang engines TP1, asleep while the trainer runs); thinking on (qwen3.5_fixed template)
